about.intro: AURALIS is a skin and hair care house from Mumbai, built where old wisdom meets current formulation: doctor-approved, steroid-free routines that are gentle enough to keep up and effective enough to photograph.
about.story:
AURALIS began with two routines and a stubborn idea: that skin and hair care should be sold the way it is prescribed — after someone has actually looked at your skin, asked what you have tried, and told you what to leave alone.

We are a skin and hair care house, not a pharmacy and not a salon. The line stays short: a brightening routine, a scalp-first hair routine, and the combos that pair them. Everything is formulated without steroids or harsh synthetics, reviewed before it is sold, and packed by hand in Mumbai with a free gift in every parcel.

More than a lakh products have gone out — online, and from the exhibition tables we set up across Maharashtra and Gujarat, where you can meet the team, see the bottles and ask the questions you would ask a friend.

We do not believe in masking problems. We believe in solving them by honouring your skin and your scalp as they are.

announcements.text: Free shipping + a free gift on every order · Doctor-approved, steroid-free formulas · DM us for a routine

policies.shipping: Orders are packed by hand in Mumbai and despatched within 2–4 working days; shipping and a gift are included on every order. Prices are shared in a DM or at the exhibition counter, and are confirmed before a parcel is sent. Payment is by UPI or bank transfer.
policies.returns: Sealed, unopened products can be returned within 7 days of delivery; opened products cannot be resold, so please ask us before buying if you are unsure a formula suits you. If a parcel arrives damaged, message us with a photograph and we will replace it.

products.name: Viral Skin Combo
products.description:
The trio behind the before-and-afters the house is known for: a brightening wash, an active serum and a barrier cream, chosen so the steps work in order. Formulated without steroids or harsh synthetics, and reviewed before it is sold.

Tell us your skin type in a DM and we will confirm whether this is the right starting set for you.
products.care: Wash morning and night, serum at night only, cream to seal. Introduce one new step at a time.
products.colour: Dullness, uneven tone and early pigmentation

products.name: Viral Hair Combo
products.description:
A scalp-first routine for fall, thinning and dullness: a gentle wash, a rosemary and onion oil and a deep mask. Nothing in it strips the scalp to make the hair look clean for a day.

This is the set the house takes to exhibitions, and the one most often reordered.
products.care: Oil the scalp an hour before washing, twice a week. Mask once a week, mid-length to ends.
products.colour: Hair fall, a dry or flaky scalp, and dull mid-lengths

products.name: Glow + Grow Duo
products.description: For the customer who wants both: the brightening serum for the face and the scalp oil for the hair, paired because they share the same logic — feed the barrier, do not attack it.
products.care: Serum at night; oil on the scalp twice a week before washing.
products.colour: Dull skin and a scalp that needs feeding

products.name: Vitamin C Brightening Face Wash
products.description: A low-foam daily wash for dull, uneven skin. Cleans without the tight feeling that sends most people reaching for a heavier cream an hour later.
products.care: Massage onto damp skin for thirty seconds, rinse with cool water, follow with serum.

products.name: Kojic + Niacinamide Serum
products.description: The active in the skin combo: a light serum aimed at dark spots, post-blemish marks and the kind of unevenness that shows up in every photograph.
products.care: Three drops on clean skin at night. Sunscreen every morning without exception.
products.colour: Dark spots, blemish marks and patchy tone

products.name: Barrier Repair Day Cream
products.description: A quiet, unscented cream that holds the routine together — comfortable under make-up, rich enough for air-conditioned days, light enough for Mumbai.
products.care: Press into damp skin after serum. Layer more on dry patches rather than switching products.

products.name: Acne Control Cleanser
products.description: For skin that breaks out along the jaw and the back — a cleanser that clears oil without leaving the barrier raw. Best used as the only active step until the skin settles.
products.care: Once a day to start. If the skin feels tight, alternate mornings.

products.name: De-Tan & Polish Scrub
products.description: A fine-grain polish for the face and body after a week in the sun — gentle enough for twice a week, and the step that makes the brightening routine look like it is working.
products.care: Use on damp skin, never on active breakouts, and follow with the day cream.

products.name: Under-Eye Caffeine Gel
products.description: A cooling gel for the mornings after a late dispatch night — de-puffs, and sits well under concealer without rolling.
products.care: Tap a grain of rice under each eye, pat — do not rub.

products.name: Rosemary & Onion Hair Oil
products.description: The oil in the hair combo: rosemary and onion, light enough to wash out in one go, made for the scalp rather than the ends. The step people skip and then wonder why the shampoo did nothing.
products.care: Section the hair, oil the scalp, leave an hour, wash with the anti-hairfall shampoo.
products.colour: Hair fall, thinning partings and a dry scalp

products.name: Anti-Hairfall Shampoo
products.description: A sulphate-free wash that cleans an oiled scalp properly without the squeak. The pair to the rosemary oil, and the reason the routine is worth following in order.
products.care: Double cleanse when the scalp is oiled. Rinse cool, and do not pile the hair on top of the head.
products.colour: Hair fall and an oily scalp

products.name: Silk Repair Conditioner
products.description: For mid-lengths and ends that have been coloured, straightened or simply lived in — slip without weight, so hair air-dries instead of being fought with.
products.care: Mid-length to ends only. Rinse with cooler water than you washed with.

products.name: Scalp Detox Serum
products.description: A light leave-in for a scalp that flakes or itches under the oil — applied at the partings, night before wash day.
products.care: Apply to partings, massage for a minute, wash the next morning.
products.colour: Flaking, itching and a congested scalp

products.name: Deep Repair Hair Mask
products.description: The mask in the hair combo: ten minutes, once a week, and the difference is in how the hair dries rather than how it feels in the shower.
products.care: After conditioner, mid-length to ends, ten minutes, rinse cool.
